race.comment: SALUDAR (2) is a lightly raced 4yo gelding for the Grahame Begg yard who wasn't beaten all that far when heavily supported at Sandown Hillside first up, finishing fifth. He should come on quickly from that and profiles nicely for this in easier company. SPARKLING AWARD (8) is building nicely with two minor placings her past two, just finding one better here last start. She should get a decent run and be right there again. HAVANA MOON (7) is coming along nicely this time in when getting into third at Mildura last time out. Rock hard fit and she'll kick up from the inside gate. SIBUN (3) was only run down late at Mildura over 1400m last time and should take catching back in trip.
